captions.detailed: This 3D model features a clip-on drafting lamp designed with a double-jaw clamp base, a dual-link arm, and a conical lampshade. The C-clamp base and vertical post are finished in matte black, while the two-link arm consists of dual parallel metallic rods joined by black plastic brackets. The lamp offers full articulation, including a horizontal swiveling joint at the top of the clamp post, a pivoting elbow joint connecting the two arm segments, and a tilting joint at the tip that connects to the light-grey conical shade.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated clip-on drafting lamp with a double-jaw clamp base, a dual-rod two-link arm, and a light-grey conical shade. The model should include a swiveling base joint, a pivoting elbow joint, and a tilting shade joint, utilizing realistic matte black and metallic materials.
captions.factory: The code constructs the drafting lamp using an articulated assembly. The clamp base is built from extruded box sections and cylinders for the screw mechanism. The vertical post is a cylinder that connects to the first link via a revolute joint. Each arm link is modeled using dual parallel cylinders representing the metallic rods, joined by box-shaped bracket assemblies. The conical lampshade is constructed using a hollowed-out cone or lofted circles. All parts are linked sequentially through revolute joints with specified rotation axes.
